display_name: 星地观测恢复器：七网络无TX标签训练与冻结F身份保真验证
description: 全部6300 L_s与56700 U_s进行合成退化配对恢复；7种网络含条件扩散与流匹配；原F基座和默认头冻结，验证真实TX净纠错、clean保持及六practical，不以NMSE或外观代替身份保真。
authorization: 本对话2026-10-19用户要求独立无监督恢复网络、覆盖IQ/FFT/PAMF输入、尝试多种设计含扩散、使用L/U；提供恢复器报告；最新明确训练默认N607并允许多GPU快速验证，直接接训练好F验证真实输入TX身份。

code.environment: N607 existing CVS-RFFI Python; actual versions in runtime preflight

data.version: original validated source physical split; no resplit
data.representation: equalized=1, center256, original packet RMS; practical residual/post_sync/noeq at25MHz
data.physical_ids_ref: same contract#role_ids; V panel chosen perRX/day without TX labels using fixed data seed
data.label_map_ref: source_cache/manifest.json#class_id_to_tx; label files read only by independent scorer
data.tx_sets_ref: all original six TX; restoration training uses no TX labels
data.validation_ref: source_cache/manifest.json: READY/EXACT_MATCH; reuse existing cache without new data validation
data.leo_config_ref: experiments/pamf_restoration/data.py: six practical residual/noEQ/fixed one source training draw per physical ID

target_panel.selection: uniform physical-ID panel; source-selected single candidate only; new six practical paired diagnostics, not historical satellite observations

permissions.regime: Phase1 source-only self-supervised recovery; source V default-head scoring/selection after predictions; then frozen target paired diagnostic
permissions.query_use: fixed per-sample prediction; all7 views and fixed stochastic diagnostics complete before independent scorer opens TX truth
permissions.claim_scope: Terrestrial proxy under added practical channel; original RX ground record recovery, no ideal TX or Phase2/real in-orbit claim; one seed does not prove stable gain

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: existing cleanF E200 and AsF T1 E20+10 source_contract and complete scratch-parent lineage; exact local source roles matched; frozen.py
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: F checkpoints VERIFIED: cleanF scratch E200/defaulthead; AsF scratch20+own10/defaulthead. Restoration inherits no weights; fixed F used only for post-freeze evaluation.
checkpoint.selection_rule: Eligible source-V model with highest frozen existing AsF low-urban accuracy; if none qualifies, source-best once for explicitly negative confirmation; exact tie: fixed candidate order. Never target scores; no expansion after source failure.

execution.gpu_policy: Physical0/1/5, max3 active run-owned GPU workers, max1 per card; other owners included in total cap2/card; require12GB free; shared capacity lock; healthy tasks preserved
execution.stop_rule: A nonfinite loss/gradient/output, channel/shape/permission error, output conflict or checkpoint mismatch stops that row and prevents unstarted rows; healthy active rows finish; preserve all outputs; no automatic retry.

metric_names: paired-clean feature vs other-TX margin (truth-side diagnostic only)
three fixed draw class switch rate
metrics_plan.primary: Compare F(received) vs F(restored) with exact same frozen AsF/default head; keep clean-through-restorer. Source thresholds: lowurban gain>=.5pp, clean drop<=.2pp, mean raw NMSE no worse and clean NMSE<=.02. Select highest source lowurban among eligible; if none, source-best once for negative target confirmation, no expansion or target-feedback tuning.

notes: Restoration pretraining contains zero TX labels, no PL or confidence gating, no frozen-F gradient training and no fitted/replaced head.
All 63,000 legal L/U IQ participate; V panel1800 has no parameter/statistic update. All physical source/target roles retain original split.

Native simulator coordinate probe: numerical delay24 samples, peak offset24 in six declared public impulse cases, kernel length62. No oracle alignment at inference; tail loss of observability reported.
Generative formal prediction: single fixed sample-ID noise draw; extra two draws first128 IDs are diagnostics only, never best-of-N or averaged.
Pure recovery only in this matrix. TX-protected fine tuning/joint PAMF training require a separate source-driven experiment and remain unlaunched.
REJECTED_EXTRA_GATE: separate design approval, duplicated unchanged-code/runner review, extra seal/hash/data revalidation are not launch conditions.
Prior F costs: cleanF E200/10,000 updates; AsF scratchE20+ownE10/6,660 updates. F weights remain frozen; this is not a matched total-training-cost architecture comparison.
